rows.grounds: fused form bhoktā + aparadveṣī; one who enjoys and does not hate faults
fused form premabhūḥ āvayoḥ bhavet; may become a loving one of us two

items.question: Which qualities identify the ideal devotee who becomes a loving companion of the divine pair?
premises: Loving one becomes of us two.
items.inference: The verse enumerates qualities culminating in loving companionship.
uncertainties: Exact sandhi and compound boundaries remain uncertain.
items.plain_english: Wealthy, an enjoyer who does not hate faults, becomes a loving one of us two.
